capabilities: define custom CSS styles in settings
apply styles to selected text via commands
apply styles from the editor context menu
remove applied styles with a Remove Style command
extras: README ends with a buy-me-a-coffee support link; setup is documented step by step but without code examples.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply arbitrary custom CSS styles to selected text while writing.
summary: CSS styling tool that lets you define custom CSS styles and apply them to selected text via commands or the editor context menu.
